children: THORChain generated about $382,000 in revenue on September 25 in U.S. local time, while trading volume exceeded $200 million. According to Foresight News, the revenue marked the highest level since April 25, and the trading volume was the second-highest since April 23, trailing only the roughly $280 million recorded on September 10.

title: THORChain Revenue Reaches Highest Level Since April 25 as Trading Volume Tops $200 Million
